tabs.title: How their journey actually unfolded.
tabs.description: Months of conversations, weekend visits, changing budgets and countless trade-offs brought Pavan & Shruti to where they are today.
tabs.roadmapTitle: How their first home and first EMI took shape

roadmapNodes.title: S1: GHAR — FINAL v1
roadmapNodes.desc: The landlord's 10% rent-hike letter and a pregnancy test shared a fridge magnet. Their first version of GHAR — FINAL was born.

roadmapNodes.title: S2: The TRUTH Column
roadmapNodes.desc: They discovered the real cost of buying: base price plus roughly 16–18% in extras. The TRUTH column became their rule for every comparison.

roadmapNodes.title: DETOUR: Neopolis Dream
roadmapNodes.desc: Sobha Neopolis sold the Greek dream on a full-page ad, but the ₹2.3–2.72 Cr reality was far beyond their range. One fight and one dosa later, the DREAMS — PARKED sheet was born.

roadmapNodes.title: REGRESSION: Chandapura Veto
roadmapNodes.desc: Three weeks were lost to the Chandapura widening idea. Shruti's veto reframed the decision: they needed a home, not a point to prove to two fathers.

roadmapNodes.title: DETOUR: Splendour Value Mirage
roadmapNodes.desc: Godrej Splendour looked like a ₹85L all-in 2BHK value win until an 8:15 am drive test revealed a 1h50m journey to Electronic City.

roadmapNodes.title: S5→S6: Hosa Road Booking
roadmapNodes.desc: They finally booked an under-construction 2BHK on Hosa Road at ₹1.22 Cr with CLP and 10% paid. It was the happiest evening of the search.

roadmapNodes.title: BOUNCE: The Project Flat-Lines
roadmapNodes.desc: Six weeks of flat-lined RERA progress triggered a 2 am buyers'-group archive dive. They fought their exit and recovered the booking amount minus ₹50K.

roadmapNodes.title: S3→S7: Ready-With-OC Pivot
roadmapNodes.desc: GST math pushed them toward a ready-with-OC home. Shriram Chirping Woods became the choice at ₹1.44 Cr all-in, with registration reaching week 32.

chatMessages.text: Riya, the showflat had bougainvillea, marre. Actual bougainvillea. I was standing in that Santorini balcony thinking… this is it, this is the one.

chatMessages.text: Then the price sheet came. Two point three crores — our whole budget is the parking-floor price there.

chatMessages.text: We don't delete the dream — we park it. A sheet named 'Dreams — Parked,' Neopolis on top with its real number next to it. Dreams with numbers stop whispering, Shruti. And Monday, we go back to Hosa Road — where your real flat is quietly waiting to exist.

tabs.name: Learnings
tabs.label: Learnings
tabs.title: What this journey teaches us.
tabs.description: Every home-buying journey leaves behind lessons. Some come from difficult decisions, others from mistakes they never want to repeat. These are the insights Pavan and Shruti wish they had known before beginning their search, and the lessons that might help someone else make a more confident decision.

lessons.title: Markets don't wait.
lessons.description: Their ₹1 Cr budget seemed realistic initially. Within two years, property prices rose to ₹1.35–1.55 Cr. Starting earlier would have offered more flexibility and choices.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A modern flat vector illustration of 1, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, Apple-inspired product aesthetics, soft ambient lighting, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: Shortlists beat browsing.
lessons.description: After comparing many listings and projects, they found more options didn't help. Focusing on a few well-matched communities made decisions easier.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A modern flat vector illustration of 2, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, Apple-inspired product aesthetics, soft ambient lighting, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: Builder trust matters.
lessons.description: Price wasn't the only factor. Quality, clear documentation, RERA compliance, and delivery history mattered as much as the floor plan.

tabs.adviceDescription: Every decision in their journey became a lesson. Looking back, Pavan and Shruti realised that confidence didn't come from visiting more projects or chasing the lowest price. It came from understanding their priorities, comparing thoughtfully and planning for the life they wanted to build. These lessons are the experiences they hope every future homebuyer can learn before beginning their own journey.

monthlyLearnings.headline: The RERA portal is genuinely readable
monthlyLearnings.body: Registration number, possession date, complaint history, quarterly updates — twenty minutes per project replaced hours of WhatsApp-forward anxiety with actual facts.

monthlyLearnings.headline: Construction-linked payment plans are the first-timer's friend
monthlyLearnings.body: 10% at booking, the rest following slabs, means the savings deplete with the building's progress, not before it.

monthlyLearnings.headline: The anxious middle tier sorts by delivery history, not brochure
monthlyLearnings.body: Two delivered projects on time beats one celebrity architect, every time.

monthlyLearnings.headline: They priced the 2.5 BHK honestly — it costs the emergency fund
monthlyLearnings.body: The 2 BHK with a convertible study won: the baby's room exists and the airbag survives.

monthlyLearnings.headline: GST maths changed the comparison more than any discount
monthlyLearnings.body: Under-construction (5%) versus ready-with-OC (nil) — they now compute all-in cost per project, not per-sqft price.
